title: Epigenetic Impacts of Non-Coding Mutations Deciphered Through Pre-Trained DNA Language Model at Single-Cell Resolution.
summary: Methven used a pretrained DNA representation with single-cell accessibility to predict non-coding mutation effects on methylation; internal and monocyte-dataset tests support a computational epigenetic result, not experimental validation of each variant.
ai_technology: Methods describe SNP–CpG modeling and CD4+ T-cell training; Results compare against prior predictors and evaluate an external monocyte dataset, including rheumatoid-arthritis-associated CpGs.
